title: What Do Indonesians Really Need from Language Technology? A Nationwide Survey
measurement_description: The paper does not directly evaluate language models on religious metrics. Instead, it measures Indonesian users' awareness of bias in language technologies through a nationwide survey, using religious and political prejudice as hypothetical examples of bias in the questionnaire.
findings: Religion was solely mentioned as a hypothetical example in a survey question exploring users' awareness of AI bias (e.g., prejudice against certain religions/politics). The study found that users who were aware of these types of bias issues were more likely to express overall concern about AI technologies (38.8% vs. 26.1% for those unaware).
